'''Lanos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. By [[3630 BBY]], he was considered the Eternal Empire's most decorated war veteran and was also known as the gladiator in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]] under the title "Supreme Vindicator". That year, Lanos was put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]." During the fight in the Arena, he was assisted by his reprogrammed [[Skytrooper]]s, but was defeated in the fifth round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lanos appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as the fifth boss of "Eternal Championship."<ref name="SWTOR" />
